name: Signal Companion
description: PS5 homebrew companion tool for controlling ps5-signal. Shows the current beeper and console-light status, can start or restart the bundled ps5-signal payload, test the beeper and LEDs, create custom light colours, save presets and edit startup beep sequences and light-show timelines. Can also add or remove ps5-signal from ps5-autoloader when sandbox access allows it.
author: Marice
